description: Everything a repository needs to plan, write and gate its documentation the way the OCX family does: the docs-quality rule with its 18 non-negotiables and seven depth files (page types, plain English, tested examples, navigation, observability, machine readers, the checks), the docs-plan skill that turns a project's own evidence into a tiered use-case list and typed page inventory, and the docs-instrument skill that retrofits the type declaration and wires every check into CI without turning every open pull request red.
name: docs-essentials
summary: The documentation design set, a merge gate for documentation, a discovery skill, and the gate-adoption skill that wires the gate into CI
